description_en: Queries the details of cloud computers
description_zh: 查询云电脑的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktops --business-channel Enterprise --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id dg-boyczi8enfyc50000 --desktop-status Running --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --user-name Alice --desktop-name DemoComputer01 --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --office-site-name default --policy-group-id system-all-enabled-policy --charge-type PostPaid --expired-time 2022-12-31T15:59:59Z --protocol-type ASP --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --end-user-id alice --excluded-end-user-id andy --filter-desktop-group false --management-flag NoFlag --query-fota-update false --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --snapshot-policy-id sp-hb12mclyne09xw000 --only-desktop-group true --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --os-types Windows --desktop-type eds.general.2c8g --image-id m-2g65ljy3ynrdq0000 --desktop-status-list Stopped --gpu-instance-group-id gp-0bm2iz1v6m6nx0000 --qos-rule-id qos-5605u0gelk2000000 --sub-pay-type monthPackage --resource-group-id rg-4hsvzbbmqdzu3s0000 --fill-resource-group true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --multi-resource false --include-auto-snapshot-policy true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktops

parameters.help_en: The business channel. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
业务渠道, 取值：
Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer pool ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer status
parameters.name: desktop_status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The username
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer name
parameters.name: desktop_name

parameters.help_en: The directory ID, which is the same as the office network ID
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The office network name
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer policy ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the cloud computer
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the subscription cloud computer.
The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月云电脑的到期时间。
时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The protocol type
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of authorized users of the cloud computer. You can specify 1 to 100 users.

Within the same time period, only one user can connect to and use the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑的授权用户列表。可设置1~100个。

在同一时段内，只有一个用户可以连接和使用该云电脑
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The authorized users to exclude. You can specify 1 to 100 users
parameters.help_zh: 要排除的云电脑授权用户列表。可设置1~100个
parameters.name: excluded_end_user_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude pooled cloud computers (cloud computers in a cloud computer pool)
parameters.help_zh: 是否排除池化云电脑（云电脑池中的云电脑）
parameters.name: filter_desktop_group

parameters.help_en: The management flag
parameters.name: management_flag

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query cloud computer image version information
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询云电脑镜像版本信息
parameters.name: query_fota_update

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify `Tag`, `Key` is required. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, contain `http://` or `https://`, or consist of only spaces
fields.help_zh: 标签键。如果传入`Tag`，则`Key`是必填的。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`，也不能仅包含空格
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. A tag is a key-value pair that is used to mark resources. You can use tags to group and manage cloud computers for easy searching and batch operations. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203781.html
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一个标签由一对键值对组成，用于标记资源。您可以使用标签来分组管理云电脑，便于搜索和批量操作，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203781.html
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The snapshot policy ID
parameters.name: snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only pooled cloud computers (cloud computers in a cloud computer pool)
parameters.help_zh: 是否只查询池化云电脑（云电脑池中的云电脑）
parameters.name: only_desktop_group

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer pool ID. If `DesktopId` is specified, `DesktopGroupId` is ignored. If `DesktopId` is empty, the system retrieves the IDs of all cloud computers in the cloud computer pool specified by `DesktopGroupId`
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑池ID。如果传入了`DesktopId`，则忽略该`DesktopGroupId`；如果`DesktopId`为空，则会根据`DesktopGroupId`去获取该云电脑池内所有云电脑的`DesktopId`
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The operating system types
parameters.name: os_types

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer specifications. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188882.html to query the supported specification IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑规格。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188882.html查询云电脑支持的规格ID
parameters.name: desktop_type

parameters.help_en: The image IDs
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer status list
parameters.name: desktop_status_list

parameters.help_en: The elastic GPU pool ID
parameters.name: gpu_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The Internet bandwidth throttling rule ID
parameters.name: qos_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The purchase method of the cloud computer
parameters.name: sub_pay_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query resource group information
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询企业资源组信息
parameters.name: fill_resource_group

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether multiple resources exist
parameters.name: multi_resource

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include automatic snapshot policy information in the response
parameters.help_zh: 是否在返回结果中包含自动快照策略信息
parameters.name: include_auto_snapshot_policy
